turns.message: I ordered black flared high-rise jeans from Myntra on 22 December 2024 for ₹495. What arrived on 28 December, sent by Navya Hosiery, was a different brand of jeans. My refund/exchange request dated 4 January 2025 was rejected without any valid reason. I contacted Myntra customer care and sent a legal notice on 17 February 2025, but nothing has been done.
